messages:
mike: Quick heads-up — kicking off a week-long access recert + KMS entitlement wrangle. Goal: reduce unnecessary admin grants, validate KMS ACLs, and surface any anomalous key usage. Volunteers to own slices?

sasha: I can take the non-prod service account/grant sweep. will produce a CSV of principals + last-used.

linh: I can run KMS ACL exports (prod & staging) and check HSM admin bindings. want to exclude infra automation keys — will coordinate with infra-ops.

priya: I'll run audit-log queries and flag suspicious patterns (external IPs, key-export events). Any preferred starting query?

mike: thanks — start with 90-day window. here's a BigQuery snippet we use: 
```sql
SELECT principal, resource_name, proto_payload.methodName AS action, COUNT(1) AS events
FROM `org-prod.logging.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.type = 'cloudkms_key'
  AND TIMESTAMP(proto_payload.@timestamp) >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY principal, resource_name, action
ORDER BY events DESC
```

linh: For on-prem KMS (HSM) I'll also run the admin-binding export and diff it against our expected list. pinging infra-ops for current expected state.

secbot: Reminder: org access-cert job scheduled Sat 04:00 UTC. It will create recert tasks for owners with >60d inactivity. :bell:

sasha: Plan for non-prod sweep: 
1) list service accounts with owner/admin roles
2) check last used via token_last_used or audit events
3) annotate if owner is a person inactive >90d -> mark for handoff or removal
4) prepare PR with role reductions and changelog
ETA: EOD Thu.

priya: found 3 principals doing suspicious key-read/export attempts from external IP blocks in last 7 days. opening tickets now.

mike: mark as high. priya please add the audit-row IDs and any correlated SSO session IDs. we'll treat as potential exfil until proven otherwise.

linh: hold off any automated prunes until priya triages — we don't want to accidentally remove a legitimate short-lived burst account.

priya: created ticket SEC-453 and attached the audit query results + preliminary IP list. assigned to @mike and @linh.

sasha: OK, I'll run my sweep but will gate any destructive steps behind a manual review if a principal appears in SEC-453.

mike: good call. next concrete steps: sasha -> non-prod sweep CSV; linh -> KMS binding report + HSM admin diffs; priya -> triage SEC-453 and search for lateral movement in the last 72h. I'll coordinate owner outreach and PRs for role reductions. daily check-in 10:00 PT for the week.

priya: ack

linh: ack

sasha: ack

mike: thanks everyone. if you spot anything urgent tag @sec-oncall and post here. :heart:
